inputs: Text only, and edits of PixelLab's own outputs. No game or third-party images uploaded.
terms: As recorded in stock-generation-records.json (PixelLab terms checked 2026-09-25).

derivations.operation: Mechanical colour key: every visible pixel whose green channel is not greater than both red and blue was made transparent (274 pixels of a dark soil disc removed, 185 kept). No pixel was drawn or moved.

request.description: Single dwarf wheat plant clump seen from directly overhead, orthographic 90-degree bird's-eye view, no side view, no horizon, roots anchored at exact canvas centre (32,32). Mature short dwarf wheat tuft: many narrow straight pointed blade leaves radiating outward from the centre like a star burst, about 7 to 9 upright golden-green grain heads (ears) seen end-on as small oval clusters near the centre. Muted olive-green leaves, pale straw-gold ears. Coarse deliberate pixel clusters, restrained industrial hard science fiction game sprite, modest realistic botanical shape, simple shading with only 3 or 4 tones, no black cartoon outline, no pot, no tray, no soil, no text, no shadow outside silhouette. Transparent background, entire silhouette within the central 52x52 of the 64x64 canvas. Clearly grass-like wheat, not a palm, flower or star. Pixel grid legible at 16x16 game scale.

records.reason: Side view of a single corn-like plant on a soil block: violates the overhead-first rule.

request.description: Wheat plant canopy seen from straight above, flat plan view looking vertically down onto the top of the plant, like a drone photo. Dense circular tuft of many thin straight narrow grass blades radiating outward from the centre point (32,32) in all directions, olive and sage green, with about eight small pale straw-gold wheat ears pointing up at the camera, so each ear appears as a short golden oval dash scattered among the inner blades. No stalk visible from the side, no ground, no soil block, no pot, no tray, no shadow. Coarse deliberate pixel clusters, simple 3-tone shading, restrained hard science fiction game sprite. Transparent background, the whole tuft inside the central 52x52 of the 64x64 canvas, readable at 16x16.

records.reason: Overhead, but a dark spiky ball of thin blades that turns to speckle at 16x16, unlike the chunky shipped lettuce and potato.

request.description: Remove all the golden yellow wheat ears from the centre and fill the centre with plain green leaf bases instead, so the young plant is entirely green leaves. Keep the size, shape, overhead view, position and pixel style exactly the same, transparent background.

Make this plant clearly sick and wilting: most leaves turn pale sickly yellow and khaki with dark brown dry tips and patches, several leaves shrivel shorter, the whole plant looks limp and faded, the ears turn dull grey-brown. It must look obviously unhealthy, very different from a healthy green plant, but not yet dead grey. Same overhead view, position and pixel style, transparent background.

records.reason: Sickly khaki with dark patches: distinct from healthy green, ripe gold and dead grey at native size.
